customer_text: My premium subscription stopped working after I was charged
agent_text: Sorry about that. We restored your Premium access after checking the account.
resolution: restore paid access after billing check

customer_text: I was charged twice for my subscription
agent_text: We refunded the duplicate charge and sent confirmation by email.

customer_text: How do I cancel Premium?
agent_text: You can cancel Premium from your account subscription page. Your benefits continue until the next billing date.

customer_text: I cannot log in because I forgot my password
agent_text: Use the password reset link on the login page and check your spam folder for the email.

customer_text: My account was hacked and the email changed
agent_text: We secured the account and started an ownership verification flow.

customer_text: The app keeps crashing on my iPhone
agent_text: Please reinstall the latest app version and send us the device and app version if it continues.

customer_text: Music keeps pausing every few seconds
agent_text: Try a different network and disable Data Saver; we can investigate with device details if it persists.

customer_text: Why is my music playing from another device?
agent_text: It looks like your account is active on another device. Sign out everywhere and change your password.
resolution: sign out everywhere and change password

customer_text: Can I listen offline with Premium?
agent_text: Yes. Download playlists while online
intent: then use Offline Mode when you have no connection.

customer_text: My student discount disappeared
agent_text: We checked eligibility and restored the student plan after verification.

customer_text: The podcast episode is missing
agent_text: Thanks for flagging it. We logged the missing episode for our content team to investigate.

customer_text: How can I change my email address?
agent_text: You can update your email under Account settings after confirming your password.

customer_text: There is a charge I do not recognize
agent_text: Please do not share card details here. We need to verify the account privately before investigating the charge.

customer_text: My family plan members cannot join
agent_text: Make sure each member is using the same home address and accepts the invitation while signed in.

customer_text: The audio quality is terrible today
agent_text: Please check the playback quality setting and your connection; we can troubleshoot further with device details.

customer_text: I want a refund for my subscription
agent_text: Refund eligibility depends on how and where you paid. Please contact the billing team privately with the receipt.

customer_text: The verification email never arrived
agent_text: Try resending it and check spam. If it still does not arrive
intent: support can verify the account another way.

customer_text: Can I use Spotify on my smart speaker?
agent_text: Spotify works with supported smart speakers; connect it from the device maker's app and select Spotify.

customer_text: My playlist vanished
agent_text: Please check Your Library filters and the correct account; support can investigate if the playlist is still missing.

customer_text: I need to change my plan
agent_text: Open Account and choose Available plans to switch. The effective date depends on your current billing cycle.
